video.title: Locale, DynamicTypeSize & LayoutDirection | Day 186
video.description:
Learn to explain how your SwiftUI views adapt to language, text size and reading direction: Locale, DynamicTypeSize & LayoutDirection, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Locale - An environment value with the user's language and region, such as number and date formats.
DynamicTypeSize - An environment value that tells you how large the user wants the text.
LayoutDirection - An environment value that says if the layout reads left to right or right to left.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Locale - An environment value with the user's language and region, such as number and date formats.
한국어: 로케일: 숫자와 날짜 형식처럼 사용자의 언어와 지역을 담은 환경 값

LayoutDirection - An environment value that says if the layout reads left to right or right to left.
한국어: 레이아웃디렉션: 레이아웃이 왼쪽에서 오른쪽인지 오른쪽에서 왼쪽인지 알려 주는 환경 값

landscape.hook: Can you explain Locale, DynamicTypeSize and LayoutDirection in English?

dialogue.title: An app for every user

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my price label shows the wrong format in France.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Read the Locale from the environment. It has the user's language and region.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the Locale knows the money format?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. Now some users say my text is too small.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: They may use a larger text size. Read the DynamicTypeSize from the environment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What do I do with the DynamicTypeSize?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Check it with `size`, and use a vertical layout when the text is very large.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Last problem. Arabic users see my icons on the wrong side.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Arabic reads right to left. Check the LayoutDirection in `dir`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So LayoutDirection can be left to right or right to left?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. SwiftUI flips most layouts, but check it for custom drawing.
Pass the Locale to the price formatter.
